// A second volume that names the SAME identifiers as the first. If anything in
// the model joined on names across files rather than on nodes, this is where it
// would show, so the fixture is chosen to make that failure visible.
const settings = { mode: "loose" };

function pick(key) {
    return settings[key];
}

class Holder {
    constructor(value) {
        this.value = value;
    }
    read() {
        return this.value;
    }
}

module.exports = { pick, Holder };
